name: American Association of Singapore
summary: Long-running American community association — events, interest groups, and soft-landing calendars that complement (not replace) the American Club.
body: The American Association of Singapore (AAS) is the community/cultural counterpart to AmCham’s business calendar and the American Club’s facilities membership. r/askSingapore “where are the Americans?” threads repeatedly land on AAS + school geography + American Club rather than nightlife density — resident Americans skew family-heavy. Use AAS for interest groups and welcome events; use AmCham when you need BD committees; use a hobby sport so not every friendship is passport-shaped. Confirm current membership tiers and event access on aasingapore.com before budgeting both AAS and a club.
membershipNotes: Association membership with event calendars — verify dues and guest rules on the official site.
